name: atlas-monorepo
description: Atlas - Cross-platform file manager inspired by VSCode

scripts.electron:build: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && npm run build:electron -w @atlas/vue-desktop && npm run build -w @atlas/electron-preload && npm run build -w @atlas/electron-main
scripts.electron:compile: npm run electron:build && electron-builder build --config electron-builder.mjs
scripts.electron:compile:mac: npm run electron:build && electron-builder build --config electron-builder.mjs --mac
scripts.electron:compile:win: npm run electron:build && electron-builder build --config electron-builder.mjs --win
scripts.electron:compile:linux: npm run electron:build && electron-builder build --config electron-builder.mjs --linux
